_note: URL query or fragment parameters that carry a credential (presigned S3/GCS/CloudFront/Azure URLs, OAuth tokens and codes, API keys, session ids, CDN tokens). Read by unsnap.py beside this file and by tools/catalog.py scan; snapshot.js runs in a browser console and carries a copy, which tools/test_kit_privacy.py keeps identical. A parameter matches case-insensitively after ?, & (or &), # or their %-encodings; a prefix matches any parameter that starts with it. A name must match whole: a *_token parameter is listed by name, since the readers have no suffix form.
